title: The Future Grid: Undaunted & 2150
desc:
The UK’s energy landscape is evolving, and so too must the grid.

​​With electricity demand rising and geopolitical pressures reshaping global energy markets, strengthening energy security and accelerating the shift to renewables has never been more urgent. Meeting this challenge will require a fundamental transformation to the UK’s national grid.

​​Cleantech has a pivotal role in this transition, unlocking smarter, more efficient systems to generate, store and manage energy.

​​This talk will explore cutting edge research and companies deploying innovative solutions to modernise the grid and make it fit for the future.

​​This event is co-hosted by Undaunted , 2150 and the Grantham Institute .

title: 41st STUOD Sandbox Workshop – Peter Korn (Max Planck Institute for Meteorology)
desc:
The 41st meeting of the Sandbox Series will be held via Webex:

https://stuod.my.webex.com/stuod.my/j.php?MTID=m67caea8c4cf9d709a92eaf2dd2ca89b7

Hasselmann’s paradigm in 3D via (LA)-SALT

Abstract:

The Crisan–Holm–Korn (2023) paper realises Hasselmann’s paradigm — fast stochastic atmosphere driving a slow deterministic ocean — in a 2D coupled (LA)-SALT model. I present a 3D extension at the discrete level, on Delaunay–Voronoi meshes. The reformulation is more than a translation. In finite dimensions, the two Kelvin circulation theorems — one per component — hold pathwise on discrete cycles rather than in expectation, and CHK’s infinite-dimensional machinery collapses to elementary SDE theory. Energy estimates yield global existence. The discrete LA-SALT system recovers Hasselmann’s…
